questions.stem: What is the $y$-intercept of the line $y = 4x - 7$?
questions.explanation: In the equation $y = mx + c$, the $y$-intercept is $c$. Here $c = -7$, so the line crosses the $y$-axis at $(0, -7)$.

questions.stem: The $y$-intercept of a line is the point where:

options.text: The line has its maximum value

questions.explanation: The $y$-intercept is the point where the line crosses the $y$-axis, i.e. where $x = 0$.
